controls.name: Start recording
controls.expected_action: Start guest/demo or live microphone practice session and audio capture.
controls.success_assertion: Recording state starts and timer advances.
controls.error_assertion: Mic denial or start failure shows a user-facing fallback and closes any opened mic stream.

controls.name: Metronome start, stop, tempo, accent, ramp
controls.expected_action: Schedule Web Audio ticks and live-update running settings.
controls.success_assertion: Running status and queue stats update.
controls.error_assertion: Unsupported browser shows a Web Audio support message.

controls.name: PDF/image/camera import and reader toolbar
controls.expected_action: Validate local file contents, render PDFs with PDF.js canvas, preview images, and persist confirmed pages locally.
controls.success_assertion: Selected score page renders and toolbar changes reader state.
controls.error_assertion: Unsupported, oversized, or render-failed files show status without upload.
controls.automated_test: frontend build and score domain tests

controls.name: Email/password and provider auth actions
controls.expected_action: Use Supabase only when configured and show guest-first disabled state otherwise.
controls.error_assertion: Raw Supabase/provider/env/URL/stack messages are mapped to friendly text.
controls.automated_test: frontend build; live provider tests externally gated

controls.name: Save pitch frame
controls.expected_action: Canonicalize note labels, cents, status, and instrument from trusted server context.

controls.name: Delete account
controls.expected_action: Clean local data before external identity deletion and record durable retry state.
controls.error_assertion: Local cleanup failure queues retry and does not call external identity deletion.

controls.name: Teacher/student ensemble actions
controls.expected_action: Enforce manager roles and active membership windows.
controls.success_assertion: Active-member summaries include only current membership window sessions.

controls.name: Hosted production smoke
controls.expected_action: Verify current Vercel and Render production behavior after deploy.
controls.success_assertion: Root, health, CORS, WebSocket hardening, browser journeys pass.

controls.name: Native practice and supporting tabs
controls.expected_action: Launch and navigate simulator app without dead primary controls.
controls.error_assertion: Real native mic, score, metronome, auth parity remains unproven.
